title: finding(react): the published `InlineEditContextValue.draft` JSDoc prescribes `draft[name] ?? data[name]`, which reads the SAVED value for a field the user emptied
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site and a measured consequence (class a). The site is a published type's documentation, and there is no in-tree victim today. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it. The site is `packages/react/src/context/InlineEditContext.tsx`, the `draft` member's JSDoc on the exported `InlineEditContextValue`.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10291 (PR objectui#10464). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact (read on `origin/main` at `e6203d756`)

The JSDoc reads: "Draft of user-edited values. Holds ONLY the keys the user actually changed … Read a field's live value as `draft[name] ?? data[name]`."

`??` falls through on `null` and `undefined`. A field the user (or a cascade clear) emptied is staged as an OWN draft key whose value is empty. The prescribed read then returns the SAVED value: the host shows, and hands its widgets, a value the user just removed. After PR objectui#10464 a cascade-cleared single select or radio stages `null`, so this is exactly the value that falls through.

## The measured consequence (relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

objectui#7190's prune probe measured this read rule on the record page's highlights strip at `cfd1f8c5`. An option widget pruned an inadmissible value, the host handed it the saved value again, and it pruned again on every render: an endless loop. The strip was fixed by reading an own draft key even when its value is empty. The strip's own comment says so ("An OWN draft key wins even when its value is undefined"), which contradicts the JSDoc. `DetailView` and `HeaderHighlight` both read with the spread, so nothing in-tree follows the JSDoc today. The trap is for a host author who copies the published doc.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix is the JSDoc sentence only: an own key wins even when empty (`name in draft ? draft[name] : data[name]`, or the spread `{ ...data, ...draft }[name]`). ⛔ No runtime change.
- `@object-ui/react` is published, so the doc ships in `dist` typings.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). `InlineEditContext` ⇒ 0. `draft[name] ?? data` ⇒ 0. `useInlineEdit` near `draft` or `saved value` ⇒ 0. Must-hit control `InlineEdit` ⇒ 6 hits.

Dedupe words: `InlineEditContext draft ?? data live value` · `useInlineEdit emptied field saved value fallback` · `draft own key undefined null prune loop`
